summary: Kerb mostly on a motorway bridge; the rest is a through road with no parking.

drivers.seclusion: Motorway lanes beneath and beside; a building about 25 m south-east at the road end.
drivers.access_and_room: No verge or pull-off; kerb is the bridge edge and a narrow footpath.
drivers.traffic: Motorway beside the line; heavy noise.
drivers.convention: No signs and no parked cars along this road.

flags: Line crosses a bridge, not parkable
sun_shade: Open to the sky; some tree shade at the east end.
